URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/21/iran-war-live-us-launches-10th-night-of-strikes-tehran-attacks-kuwait
NOTE: Al Jazeera live blog (Tue 21 Jul, updates through ~06:00 GMT). Confirms 10th consecutive night of US strikes; White House says strikes continue until Trump decides otherwise. Explosions across southern Iran: Qeshm Island, Bandar Abbas, Sirik, Chabahar, Isfahan, Konarak. Kuwait air defences activated against Iranian missile/drone attacks. Iran's army claims ground-to-ground missiles at "US HIMARS missile systems" at Camp Arifjan, Kuwait (18th phase of "Thunder" operation). IRGC claims strike on Amazon central data infrastructure in Bahrain via cruise missiles (Tasnim). Iran says 2 tankers on fire in Hormuz. Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni arrived Islamabad on official visit (stated aim: strengthen ties, triple trade to $10bn/yr target); Pakistan interior minister said he looked forward to supporting efforts to ease regional tensions.
